Rebecca

I recently needed an appointment for a constant headache and was sent to another surgery as the above couldn’t fit me in. Whilst there, the new doctor questioned why nobody had investigated my high blood pressure. I had no idea. Due to the new doctors instruction, Greystones organised a nurse to take my blood pressure which was sky high. The nurse was supposed to call me back, she never did. My wife called and arranged another appointment for the nurse to call me which she then did. She said she would organise a prescription for me to pick up from my local Boots, she didn’t. I had to call the following week to organise the prescription myself. Now to today…. due to the potential damage my medication can cause to my liver, I was given an appointment to return to Greystones today for a blood test to check my liver function. I received a reminder this morning then a phone call almost immediately after to tell me it was cancelled. My mother died of a stroke at my age, if it was down to Greystones, I suspect I’d be going the same way. What an atrocious way to treat a patient.

Edit: just to cap it off, I was sent a text after the above to go to the drive in phlebotomist that closes at 5pm. I arrived at 4:15 and wasn’t allowed in due to the queue. Really, could things get any worse?

Three weeks later….. I’m about to run out of blood pressure tablets and heard nothing from Greystones medical centre. I think I’m supposed to have another blood test for liver function and don’t know if I’m going to get a repeat prescription, if the pills are damaging my liver, are the pills working? I know nothing. My wife called the surgery to try to find out what is going on and I’ve received a text telling me that ‘my request will be reviewed within two days’! My pills run out in two days. No idea what the ‘request’ is!

Seriously, how worse can patient care really get? I’ve absolutely no idea what is going on.",null,[0,232]]]],[null,1751022108000000,1751022146000000,"8 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/16626832455524947540/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZPVkJpWDNSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16626832455524947540/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZPVkJpWDNSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/16626832455524947540/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZPVkJpWDNSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16626832455524947540/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZPVkJpWDNSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/16626832455524947540/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZPVkJpWDNSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16626832455524947540/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZPVkJpWDNSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,["en"],[["Dear Jay

We take all patients feedback seriously and would be happy to look into this further and address your concerns if you would like to contact the surgery.
